verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is clearly a managed cloud service: multi-tenant is the default deployment, with single-tenant and BYOC options, and the docs describe the object-storage architecture and native client SDKs. Programmatic provisioning is only partly evidenced. Namespaces can be created and managed through the API (branching creates copy-on-write clones, cross-region copies, prefix listing, per-test namespaces, namespace pinning), but API tokens are created and expired in the dashboard. missing for 10: documented API/IaC provisioning of accounts, tokens, and single-tenant/BYOC deployments, an explicit namespace-creation API, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
